title: How an ecosystem restoration community is regenerating water cycles to mitigate forest fires in Portugal
content: Rewetting and restoring wetlands, building small dams, and restoring streams create landscape-level breaks that disrupt fire spread by retaining water in the land instead of letting it run off. EcoAtivo is putting this approach into practice.
